timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I'll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you'll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let's begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can have good dreams tonight.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I'm allowed to set an intention before I fall asleep.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can choose what I want to carry into my dreams.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I know what I'd like to dream about tonight.
I can picture it clearly, just for myself.
I can dream of whatever I want.
I'm going to set an intention for dreaming.
I'm going to have a good dream.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I will have a good dream tonight.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Let that dream find you tonight.
